memories.memory: I get recurring migraines about once or twice a month, especially after long days working under gallery lighting, and I usually need to lie in a dark room for several hours.
My doctor diagnosed me with mild hypertension in 2022, and I now take amlodipine 5 mg each morning while trying to keep track of my blood pressure at home.
I strained my right knee while helping install a large exhibition last spring, and physiotherapy twice a week has helped, although stairs still cause occasional pain.
For several months in 2024, I met with a therapist about burnout and irritability caused by taking on too many arts projects at once.
A sleep study showed that I have mild obstructive sleep apnea, so I was given a CPAP machine, but I still struggle to use it consistently when traveling for exhibitions.
I developed a persistent rash on my hands after using industrial paints, and a dermatologist prescribed a steroid cream and advised me to wear nitrile gloves in the studio.
After a routine blood test showed low vitamin D and borderline high cholesterol, I started a daily vitamin D supplement and was asked to repeat the tests after three months.
